model: mask-full-probe-v21a (hssr_mask.bin): the per-cell rear-eligibility student, run as the control worker's third job; provenance and the DEV row in manifest.json
harness: stereo_upmix_render --mask-model v21a.msk1 --mask-drive-prod 1.5 --vocal-gate 0.5 --rear-air -9 on top of VARIANTS['cand_noair'] (upmix_stem_tests.py --render-extra)

AUDIO_HSSR_MASK_MODEL.what: unset = hssr_mask.bin beside AUDIO_HSSR_MODEL; absent file = mask off

AUDIO_HSSR_MASK_DRIVE.what: object = sqrt(eligibility) * drive (clamped at 1.45 in the render), pan = the bin's own L/R balance; 0 = off (heuristic path), range 0..2. Car + harness 27.09: 1.0 thin (guitars 0.07), 1.7 = the 22.09 leak (voice 0.10, swing back), 1.5 = guitars 0.17 / voice 0.08 (4 songs >15 % vs 8) / guitars' relative swing 1.78 vs 2.35 (22.09), all 40 songs

AUDIO_HSSR_VOCAL_GATE.what: the soft veto over the mask (see models/hssr-selection-v11/settings.json)

AUDIO_HSSR_MASK_TREBLE_DB.what: mask drive shelf above ~2.5 kHz, -12..12 dB; unset = flat. +3/+6 raised drums (0.44/0.50) and voice faster than guitars on the harness

AUDIO_HSSR_MASK_GAMMA.what: eligibility exponent 0.1..1; unset = 1. 0.7/0.5 lifted voice to 0.14/0.16 and drums past 0.5: the student's voice/guitar contrast is too small for it
